from cifar10_models.resnet import resnet18
import torch, torchvision
import torchvision.transforms as T
m = resnet18(pretrained=True)
dev = 'cuda' if torch.cuda.is_available() else 'cpu'
m.eval().to(dev)
tf = T.Compose([T.ToTensor(),
                T.Normalize((0.4914, 0.4822, 0.4465), (0.2471, 0.2435, 0.2616))])
ds = torchvision.datasets.CIFAR10('./cifar', train=False, download=True, transform=tf)
dl = torch.utils.data.DataLoader(ds, batch_size=256, num_workers=2)
c = t = 0
with torch.no_grad():
    for x, y in dl:
        p = m(x.to(dev)).argmax(1).cpu()
        c += (p == y).sum().item(); t += y.size(0)
print(f"top-1 accuracy: {100*c/t:.2f}")
PYEOF
